issues.description: TSK_SPRP_FINISH_BEAM rate_range_high (170) was below rate_per_hour (225). The spray rate at 225 LF/hr is valid but the range did not encompass it. rate_range_low was 50 which is below the brush rate (90 LF/hr).
issues.suggested_fix: Corrected rate_range_low to 75, rate_range_high to 250 to encompass both spray (225) and brush (90) rates with standard variance.

issues.description: Beam profile modifier naming differs between resolution (rectangular, chamfered, curved, ornate) and production (small_box, standard_box, large_timber, ornate). Production refined the NC arch element names to more descriptive terms. Similarly, column_type expanded from 3 levels (resolution) to 4 levels (production), and mantel_type uses different labels (shelf_only/standard_surround/full_assembly vs simple_shelf/traditional/ornate).
issues.suggested_fix: Acceptable divergence — production refined resolution's preliminary names with more descriptive labels based on NC source data. Production values are authoritative. Engine should consume production modifier IDs.

issues.description: FAC_BUILTIN_DEPTH DEEP modifier value is 1.25x in production but 1.30x in resolution. Small discrepancy (0.05x) — production value reflects NC source calibration.
issues.suggested_fix: Accept production value (1.25x) as authoritative — derived from NC SF_BUILTIN_NC production data. Update resolution if needed for spec.json assembly.

issues.description: SOP task_count_summary phase_detail says 'finish_12' includes '2 final inspect/touchup' but TSK_SPRP_FINAL_INSPECT and TSK_SPRP_TOUCHUP are in MOD_SPRP_CLEANUP (cleanup phase), not MOD_SPRP_FINISH. The by_phase count says 'cleanup: 7' but MOD_SPRP_CLEANUP actually has 9 tasks. Phase_detail text is inconsistent with actual module placement.
issues.suggested_fix: Cosmetic labeling issue in summary section. Actual module structure and task placement is correct. by_module counts (CLEANUP: 9) are accurate. by_phase rollup should be: setup=6, prep=21, prime=6, interstage=6, finish=10, cleanup=9. Note: finish=10 + cleanup=9 = 19, not finish=12 + cleanup=7 = 19. Same total.

issues.description: Worst-case prep stacking for wood ceiling (coffered + POOR + H3 = 4.05x) and beam (ornate + POOR + H3 = 4.20x) marginally exceed the 4.0x flag threshold. Built-in worst-case (5.27x) substantially exceeds it but requires extremely unlikely combination (very_deep + ornate + restricted + POOR).
issues.suggested_fix: Flagged in MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING already. Estimator review mandatory when prep stack exceeds 4.0x. Consider QT5+POOR gate to hourly rate (COMPAT_011 in materials.json). No code fix needed.
